audit.whatIsWrong: Lulu is listed female in champ-data/champ-gender.js (the authority) but loading, report[8].t and report[10].t call her "his".
audit.why: Every third-person pronoun refers to Lulu and must be her/she.
audit.corrected: Swap the three instances to her/she.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side are all the unfilled "Skill" placeholder, and the level 1-3 why text (index 0-2) describe Renata's own kit even though content win[0..2] all say Lulu wins those rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart (Lulu,Lulu,Lulu,Renata,Renata,Renata,Renata) matches content win[] exactly — Lulu's poke and Whimsy polymorph deny the early lane, then Renata takes over once she can bait Whimsy and land Hostile Takeover.
audit.corrected: Side to Lulu on rows 0-2, Renata on rows 3-6; rewrite the level 1-3 whys around Pix poke/Glitterlance/Whimsy instead of Renata's own kit.
